mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly demand (GDPC1) signals corporate investment and consumer spending growth, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between GDPC1 and returns falls below 0.05 over any 20-day window, or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 in the direction of positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate below 2.5% triggers accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equities and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses below 2.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicates economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between GDPC1 and INDPRO on returns is insignificant (IC < 0.05 over 20 days).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in CPIAUCSL below 2.0% during a late-cycle expansion signals deflationary pressures, prompting risk-on asset flows and positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses below 2.0 in the next month
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, 20-day forward returns do not rise when CPIAUCSL falls below 2.0% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (lower unemployment) reflects labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls but 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST (demand in thousands of units) crossing above 2200 signals a surge in demand, prompting inventory buildup and positive equity returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 2200 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise when HOUST crosses above 2200 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and HOUST (another demand measure) amplifies economic activity, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and HOUST on returns is insignificant (IC < 0.05 over 20 days).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS (rate hikes) and falls in GDPC1 (demand) signal contractionary policy, reducing growth expectations and generating negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: During tightening cycles, 60-day forward returns do not decline significantly (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS rising and GDPC1 falling.
